# Overview of Session 3 {#sec-s3}

In Sessions 1 and 2 you worked with single numbers: one price, one break-even volume. A business rarely stops at one number. It wants to know what happens to cost, revenue and profit **for every possible volume**, and how sales develop over time. The tool for that is a function: a rule that turns any input into an output. Functions are also the idea behind every spreadsheet formula and every line of code you will write later in this module.

::: {.goals}
Goals

After this session you can:

- describe a function by formula, table and graph, and move between the three;
- interpret the slope and intercept of a linear function in business terms;
- set up cost, revenue, profit and average cost functions;
- find the maximum of a quadratic profit function;
- model growth with exponential functions and answer "how long until…?" with logarithms.
:::
